meta.description: A small robot with a collapsing pill (greeting · balance) appears near the bottom-right corner of the window, just above the message composer; click the robot or pill to expand details: account, connection state with a one-click reconnect, today's spend estimate (balance delta, ignoring top-ups; spending before the plugin was installed cannot be counted), top-up balance, last update, and shortcuts to the Platform usage/top-up pages; a privacy toggle hides amounts, and drag remembers the bubble position. Click × to dismiss it; it appears again on the next page load. Control labels are localized; the greeting stays Chinese. Balance is read through the DSH account service, so the browser never sees the account token; a signed-out or failed read shows “--”. The plugin makes no network requests of its own and collects no data. Disable or remove the bundle under Plugins to remove it.
